name: eq.resume_session.v1
doc: Comparison conditions for the resume-session family: a replacement agent must report twelve facts about an interrupted session. Baseline reconstructs from the rendered history; assisted resumes from a committed checkpoint. Frozen before any pair is measured.
heldConstant: the twelve questions and their oracle
the rendered history bytes (baseline) and the checkpoint bytes (assisted), both pinned by digest
the 40-tool-call cap, applied to both arms
permittedDifferences: the arm's inputs: history (baseline) versus checkpoint (assisted) -- this is the treatment
how the arm searches or reads
invalidatingDifferences: an arm that saw the other arm's directory
a cap applied to one arm only
a different model or effort between the arms of one pair
a fact answered by consulting the ontology repository's documents rather than the history or checkpoint
failureRecoveryPolicy: a failed or over-cap arm stays in the cohort with its full cost; UNKNOWN answers are honest failures and are counted, never re-run
tokenAccountingBasis: anthropic messages-api usage, observed-2026-09-10 layout; one measurement per requestId
